description: A project's register of sources as a BibTeX file's text: one entry per source, its key the source's (what \cite{} and [@KEY] name), the identifiers as eprint/archivePrefix (arXiv), doi, mrnumber, zbl, isbn; a source with the † says so in a comment above its entry. 'keys' narrows it to those sources. A paper's build fetches the same file by token at /api/projects/{project}/sources.bib, with an ETag. Anybody who sees the project.

keys.description: Only these sources: keys separated by commas, e.g. 'GS90,IMP26'.

name: export_sources_bib
title: Export sources bib
